title: Arcana Core Field: Important Systems
summary: Read the Arcana Core services that keep magic data consistent across addons.

blocks.title: Shared Services
blocks.body: Arcana Core services own aether state, spell definitions, ritual records, curse records, relic lifecycle contracts, and optional provider interfaces.

blocks.title: Runtime Bridges
blocks.body: Optional runtime bridges can report Veilbound pressure, scan counts, or field journal state while keeping the Echo-side code dedicated-server safe.

blocks.title: Stable IDs
blocks.body: Most Arcana failures start as ID drift. Keep module ids, route ids, archive ids, and provider ids aligned before adding more content.

blocks.title: State Check
blocks.body: Use the system note to read the current state, then choose one action that answers it.
